name: Spaceworker Browser Clone
description: Clone your browser profile to spaceworker
_comment: TASK_119B (B9-B). host_permissions <all_urls> is REQUIRED by chrome.cookies: the 'cookies' permission ALONE returns nothing for a host the extension holds no host permission for, which looks exactly like a broken feature. The owner chose all-sites capture (no domain picker), so this is deliberate - and the install prompt it produces is broad ('Read and change all your data on all websites'). The origins above are the REAL app origins (lib/exe-runtime.ts HOSTED_APP_URL / APP_BASE_URL); the previous spaceworker.yourcompany.com was a placeholder that does not exist. popup.js APP_ORIGIN carries the same value and must change together with this list.
